artifact: TiBLA v4 commercial-API evaluation provenance manifest
status_statement: Auditable and deterministically re-scorable from archived derived detections. Not fully reproducible: raw API responses were not retained, so native label mappings and provider metadata cannot be re-derived without re-calling the services.

run.timestamp_source: prediction run logs + S3 object LastModified 2026-08-29 14:04-14:05

sdk_versions_best_effort.note: Not lock-pinned at run time; values are those installed in the run virtualenv and are consistent with the run.

run.batching: ThreadPoolExecutor, 8 workers, one page per synchronous request

scoring.canonical_fold: classes {0 header, 3 footer} -> header-footer (matched individually); class 1 -> one text-area envelope per page (max conf); class 2 -> footnote; matches at IoU>=0.5
scoring.note: iter_pages() enumerates the 833 ground-truth stems and reads <pred_dir>/<stem>.txt; a missing prediction file would be scored as an empty prediction. All 833 stems verified present in every provider dump (0 missing, 0 extra).

services.region: UNKNOWN (resource endpoint held in an environment variable, not recorded)
services.model_mutability: api-version pins the API contract; the underlying model may be updated by the provider under the same api-version. Served model version UNKNOWN and mutable.
services.input_handling: raw JPEG bytes, Content-Type application/octet-stream; no resize/rotate/preprocess
services.geometry: paragraphs[].boundingRegions[0].polygon -> axis-aligned bbox, normalized by pages[0].width/height, clamped to [0,1]

services.api_version: UNKNOWN (Textract exposes no user-selectable model/API version; the deployed Layout model is service-managed)
services.model_mutability: Versionless managed service; the Layout model may be updated by the provider at any time with no version handle. Served model version UNKNOWN and mutable.

native_to_tiblad_map.footnote: absent (no footnote type) -> footnote F1 = 0 by construction

services.geometry: Geometry.BoundingBox {Left, Top, Width, Height} (already normalized 0..1) -> center/size, clamped
services.per_box_confidence_note: per-block Confidence/100 retained as the 6th label column
services.operating_point: fixed at confidence 0.00 (no Textract validation predictions were generated, so no validation-selected point). The test-set best-mean-F1 confidence is also 0.00, so the fixed point coincides with the test optimum; selection used no test tuning.

services.model_mutability: NONE observed: processor version explicitly pinned; v1.5/v1.6 release-candidate versions were avoided because they return empty bounding boxes (known provider-side bug).
services.input_handling: application/pdf: each JPEG re-encoded into a single-page PDF via PIL (convert('RGB').save(format='PDF')), because Layout Parser rejects image/*. This preprocessing step is not applied to Azure/Textract.

native_to_tiblad_map.footnote: absent (no footnote type) -> footnote F1 = 0 by construction

services.geometry: document_layout.blocks walked recursively; bounding_box.normalized_vertices (or vertices/W,H) -> center/size, clamped
services.s3_labels_note: S3 prefix uses 'gdocai'; the canonical system id in the scorer is 'google_docai'.

manifests.method: Per file: 'sha256sum <relative-basename>'. Entries sorted bytewise (LC_ALL=C) by relative filename. No absolute paths in hashed content. Aggregate = sha256 of the sorted manifest file.
manifests.stem_alignment: All five manifests share an identical set of 833 page stems (0 missing, 0 extra).

detections_in_repo.note: The derived detections are committed to this repository so the manifest is self-contained and independently verifiable with no S3 credentials. Payload is small (~267 KB total), so it is stored as reproducible per-provider gzip tarballs rather than Git LFS/Xet.
detections_in_repo.verify: ./verify.sh --detections ./detections  (checksum-verifies + extracts the tarballs and checks every per-file SHA-256 against sha256/, no network)

archive_access.note: Original archive location; the same derived detections are now also committed in-repo under detections/ (see detections_in_repo).
archive_access.access_conditions: Authenticated AWS access required. Anonymous listing returns AccessDenied and anonymous HTTPS GET returns HTTP 403 (checked 2026-09-07). The objects are not publicly downloadable without credentials.
